name: romanfedorskij/message-bus
description: Attribute-driven PHP message bus with flows, compiled registry, queue transport contracts, and immutable envelopes

suggest.php-di/php-di: Recommended PSR-11 container for standalone PHP applications.
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: Recommended for Symfony applications, with PSR-11 compatible service access.
suggest.level-2/dice: Alternative DI container option when exposed through a PSR-11 compatible adapter.
suggest.ext-pcntl: Required only for worker:run --mode=auto and PcntlAutoWorkerRunner.
suggest.ext-posix: Required only for worker:run --mode=auto process liveness checks and child signalling.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required only for PostgreSQL queue transport.
suggest.ext-pgsql: Useful for PostgreSQL queue transport diagnostics and native PostgreSQL support.
